request: Build a small Jac web app for a travel blog. An author creates posts with a title, a description and one category from travel, nature, city, adventure and beaches, and can mark a post as featured. The home page shows featured posts first and lets a reader filter posts by category. Keep the post rules in a reusable service.
acceptance: Posts can be created with exactly one of the five categories; any other category is rejected.
Featured posts are listed before the others on the home page.
Filtering by a category shows only that category's posts.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and a fullstack Jac app.
Keep the logic deterministic and independent of external APIs.

source.note: Requirements paraphrased in English from the repository README/description; no code copied.
